title: Getting Organized Setup Checklist
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: An interactive checklist of the five first steps and the core setup tasks for getting organized, with a progress ring and a note on why each task matters.

learningObjectives: Students will carry out the five first steps and the core setup tasks of getting organized, tracking their progress toward a complete organizational system.

keyQuestions: Why should the dedicated email come before the Common App account?
Which task would cost you the most time if you skipped it?
Who in your family will help with which tasks?
commonMisconceptions: Organization can wait until applications open.
A personal or school email is fine for college accounts.
assessmentOpportunities: Students complete the five first steps and can explain the purpose of at least three foundation tasks.
